overview:
The Kashmir Premium Luxury Escape is a 7-day holiday designed for travellers who want to explore Kashmir's famous destinations while enjoying comfortable stays and convenient travel arrangements.

Starting and ending in Srinagar, this Kashmir luxury tour package features the region's iconic lakes, gardens, mountain meadows, and scenic valleys. Enjoy a private Shikara ride on Dal Lake, explore Srinagar's Mughal gardens, and take day excursions to Gulmarg, Pahalgam, and Sonamarg.

Whether you are planning a romantic holiday, a family vacation, or a relaxing Himalayan escape, this itinerary combines sightseeing, leisure, and optional premium experiences.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar – Luxury Stay and Shikara Ride
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Srinagar Airport, where a Safar Trails representative will welcome you and arrange a private transfer to your premium hotel or luxury houseboat.

After check-in, relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. In the evening, experience a private Shikara ride on Dal Lake, taking in the beautiful lake views and surrounding mountains. You can also explore the scenic Boulevard Road area.

Return to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Arrival at Srinagar Airport & private transfer to premium hotel or luxury houseboat
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check-in, relaxation, and taking in the peaceful surroundings
itinerary.eveningActivity: Private Shikara ride on Dal Lake & scenic Boulevard Road walk

itinerary.title: Srinagar Sightseeing – Mughal Gardens and Heritage
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore Srinagar's famous Mughal gardens and cultural landmarks.

Visit Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and Pari Mahal, admired for their landscaped gardens and scenic settings. Continue to Shankaracharya Temple, subject to access and local conditions, followed by Hazratbal Shrine.

Spend the evening exploring local markets and shopping for Kashmiri handicrafts and traditional souvenirs.

Return to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & visit to Mughal Gardens (Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, Pari Mahal)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Visit to Shankaracharya Temple (subject to access) & Hazratbal Shrine
itinerary.eveningActivity: Exploring local markets for Kashmiri handicrafts & traditional souvenirs

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg – Scenic Mountain Excursion
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to Gulmarg through the beautiful landscapes of the Kashmir Valley.

Explore Gulmarg's picturesque meadows and enjoy views of the surrounding Himalayan mountains. You may opt for the famous Gondola cable car ride, subject to ticket availability, weather, and operational conditions.

Seasonal snow activities and pony rides may also be available at an additional cost. Later, return to Srinagar for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & scenic drive through Kashmir Valley landscapes to Gulmarg
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore picturesque meadows, mountain views & optional Gondola ride
itinerary.eveningActivity: Return to Srinagar for dinner and an overnight stay

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam – Luxury Valley Experience
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, depart for Pahalgam and enjoy the scenic countryside along the route. En route, visit the saffron fields of Pampore, subject to the season.

Upon arrival, explore the beautiful landscapes of Pahalgam and visit Betaab Valley and Aru Valley. A visit to Chandanwari may also be arranged, depending on road conditions, weather, and local vehicle regulations.

Return to Srinagar in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, drive to Pahalgam & visit saffron fields of Pampore (seasonal)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Chandanwari (access permitting)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Return to Srinagar for dinner and an overnight stay

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Sonamarg – Himalayan Scenic Excursion
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed towards Sonamarg, enjoying spectacular mountain views along the way.

Explore the scenic valley and visit the Thajiwas Glacier area, subject to weather and local accessibility. Optional pony rides may be arranged locally, depending on availability and conditions.

Spend some leisure time surrounded by Kashmir's natural beauty before returning to Srinagar.

Dinner and overnight stay at your accommodation.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & drive to Sonamarg with spectacular mountain views
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore the scenic valley & visit Thajiwas Glacier area (subject to accessibility)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Leisure time in nature and return to Srinagar for dinner & overnight stay

itinerary.title: Srinagar Leisure – Premium Experiences and Shopping
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy a relaxed day in Srinagar at your own pace.

Explore local markets for Kashmiri handicrafts, dry fruits, and traditional products. You may also choose optional experiences such as a spa session, an additional Shikara ride, or a private cultural experience, subject to availability and additional charges.

Enjoy a leisurely evening before returning to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & relaxed morning in Srinagar at your own pace
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Browse local markets for Kashmiri handicrafts, dry fruits, and traditional products
itinerary.eveningActivity: Optional spa session, Shikara ride, or cultural experience; dinner at accommodation

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel or houseboat and enjoy a private transfer to Srinagar Airport for your onward journey.

Depart with wonderful memories of Kashmir's scenic valleys, peaceful lakes, beautiful gardens, and unforgettable Himalayan landscapes.

Your Kashmir Premium Luxury Escape concludes with Safar Trails.

itinerary.afternoonActivity: Private transfer to Srinagar Airport for onward journey
itinerary.eveningActivity: Tour concludes with wonderful Himalayan memories

topPlacesToVisit.name: Srinagar – Lakes, Gardens and Heritage
topPlacesToVisit.description: Srinagar is the starting point of your Kashmir holiday, offering a blend of scenic lake views, historic gardens, religious landmarks, and local culture. Places to explore include Dal Lake, Boulevard Road, Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, Pari Mahal, Shankaracharya Temple, and Hazratbal Shrine. Recommended experience: A private Shikara ride on Dal Lake.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Gulmarg – Mountain Meadows and Gondola Ride
topPlacesToVisit.description: Gulmarg is known for its scenic meadows and impressive Himalayan surroundings. It is a popular stop for travellers seeking mountain views and seasonal outdoor experiences. Explore the Gulmarg meadows, enjoy panoramic mountain scenery, and opt for a Gondola cable car ride (subject to availability).

topPlacesToVisit.name: Pahalgam – Scenic Valleys and Nature
topPlacesToVisit.description: Pahalgam offers beautiful valley landscapes and peaceful natural surroundings, making it a highlight of many Kashmir holiday itineraries. Places to explore include Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, Chandanwari (subject to local access conditions), and the saffron fields of Pampore when in season.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Sonamarg – Himalayan Landscapes and Glacier Views
topPlacesToVisit.description: Sonamarg is a scenic mountain destination known for its valley views and access to the Thajiwas Glacier area. Enjoy scenic mountain drives, explore the Sonamarg valley, visit the Thajiwas Glacier area (subject to accessibility), or opt for a local pony ride if available.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Kashmiri Shopping and Local Experiences
topPlacesToVisit.description: During your stay in Srinagar, explore local markets for traditional handicrafts, dry fruits, and Kashmiri products. Optional cultural experiences and spa sessions may be arranged according to availability and your preferences.
